description: A machine has output \(y\) at input \(x\) if and only if some bounded run reaches a halted state whose specified output is \(y\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MachinesAndComputationHistories.compute_output
  (M : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MachinesAndComputationHistories.Machine) (x y : ℕ) :
  y ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MachinesAndComputationHistories.compute M x ↔
    ∃ t,
      M.halt (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MachinesAndComputationHistories.run M x t) = true ∧
        M.output (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MachinesAndComputationHistories.run M x t) = y
